market_summary: Nifty closed at 25,255 on 11 Nov, up 0.84%. Foreign investors bought ₹12,563 cr that day. India VIX is 17.5, so expect normal swings. Q2 FY27 results season is still running.

buy_ideas.name: Minda Corporation
buy_ideas.thesis: Revenue up 43% and profit up 69% year on year. Revenue beat estimates by 10.7% and margins improved despite higher raw material costs. Growth from EV parts and digital displays.
buy_ideas.risks: Auto demand could slow. Mid-cap, so it swings more.

buy_ideas.name: Apollo Hospitals
buy_ideas.thesis: Revenue up 21% and profit up 32%, both above estimates. 1,800 new beds coming; three loss-making hospitals expected to break even by March.
buy_ideas.risks: Valuation is already high, and new hospitals take time to fill.

buy_ideas.name: Va Tech Wabag
buy_ideas.thesis: Profit up 23% and a record ₹20,207 cr order book.
buy_ideas.risks: Project delays and late customer payments.

buy_ideas.name: Bharti Airtel
buy_ideas.thesis: Profit up 31% and revenue per user about ₹271 after tariff hikes. Steady, lower-upside hold.
buy_ideas.risks: Profit missed some analyst estimates; network costs are rising.

buy_ideas.name: Gujarat Fluorochemicals
buy_ideas.risks: Upside depends on new plants starting on time.

avoid.reason: Hit upper circuit after results, but ₹73.5 cr of profit was a one-time gain and margins slipped. Don't chase.
Up 263% this year and on the exchange's ASM surveillance list.
Jumped about 7%, but profit excluding one-offs was flat.

portfolio_notes.BHARTIARTL: Results already out (early Nov): strong growth but a slight estimate miss. Fine to hold with a stop; lower upside than fresh earnings beats.
portfolio_notes.KALYANKJIL: Post-results jump driven partly by a one-time gain. Avoid re-entering on momentum.
